stories.title: Early trade deadline questions: Knicks, Thunder and other contenders' next steps
stories.summary: With the NBA trade deadline looming, which title contenders should -- and could -- make a deal to improve?

stories.title: Sources: Ole Miss RB Lacy to miss rest of season; could return or enter draft
stories.summary: Ole Miss running back Kewan Lacy, who has one year of eligiblity remaining, will miss the rest of the season with a left shoulder injury, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Browns' Verse says he met with team psychiatrist to try to snap sack slump
stories.summary: Browns defensive end Jared Verse said Thursday that he recently met with the team's psychiatrist to try to get past his slump of not registering sacks.

stories.title: Sources: Former Saint Louis star Avila finalizing deal to play for TCU
stories.summary: Former Saint Louis star Robbie Avila, the 2025 A-10 Player of the Year, is finalizing a deal to play for TCU this season, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: FIFA loses New York court ruling against UEFA in World Cup investor case
stories.summary: A judge in Manhattan denied requests by FIFA subsidiaries to block UEFA's attempts to get evidence about Gianni Infantino's failed World Cup investor plan.
